properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 20 at 8:30AM EST until November 20 at 12:30PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
FFWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northern Brevard County in east central Florida...
Northeastern Seminole County in east central Florida...
Southeastern Volusia County in east central Florida...

* Until 1230 PM EST.

* At 830 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated showers and thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches
of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 2 to 4 inches
are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Port Orange, New Smyrna Beach, Edgewater, Oak Hill, Maytown,
Bethune Beach, Apollo Beach, Ponce Inlet, Glencoe, Farmton, Turtle
Mound, Lake Ashby, New Smyrna Beach Airport, Eldora, Samsula-Spruce
Creek and Shiloh.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.
